title: Descriptive and recount — Level 8 — Arrange the text

items.prompt: Urutkan kalimat recount: (1) Then we swam. (2) Last Sunday we went to the beach. (3) Finally, we went home.
Urutkan: (1) After that, we had lunch. (2) First, we visited the museum. (3) Yesterday my class had a field trip. (4) We were happy.
Kalimat mana yang paling tepat menjadi kalimat pertama descriptive text tentang zebra? (1) It has black and white stripes. (2) The zebra is a wild animal from Africa. (3) It eats grass.

visual.text: 1 or 3

choices.say: 1 or 3

items.reteach: Identification (memperkenalkan) ada di awal: The zebra is …
